Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Approved

The Noida Metro Aqua Line's expansion has been approved. The project will extend the line by 8.44 km and include 5 elevated stations. The extension will connect Sector-61, fulfilling a long-standing demand for residents of Noida Extension.
